profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at ExoTerra Resource

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
positions.description: Develop and optimize embedded software using C, C++, and Python, ensuring reliability and performance. Design and implement communication protocols, for seamless system integration. Work with microcontrollers and real-time operating systems (RTOS) to deliver responsive and efficient solutions. Debug and troubleshoot embedded systems at both software and hardware levels to ensure functionality and performance.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · C++ · CAN bus · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Linux · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Git · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Docker · MATLAB · Agile Application Development

positions.title: Data Services Intern
positions.description: Created a user friendly dashboard to help display failures in calculations, gathering information from multiple data sources.  Applied a slowly changing schema in BigQuery to capture daily business calculations.  Participated in sprint planning and design implementation meetings with cross-functional departments
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Google BigQuery · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description: Help students with a variety of common core subjects such as Calculus (I, II, III), Differential equations, Physics I & II, Circuits, programming concepts, C++, Python, SQL

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Created online electrical safety protocols for equipment in a mineral processing plant.  Tested new safety protocol software and created videos to teach plant managers how to use the software.  Presented project and implementation challenges to company leadership for national replication.

positions.title: Junior Software Tester
positions.description: Tested app and website for usability and functionality, as requested by senior developers.  Created bug reports and conducted regression testing when issues were reported as fixed.  Participated in brainstorming and design team meetings.

volunteerExperiences.description: Tutored third grade students in math and science.

projects.title: Senior Design: Bicycle safety device
projects.description: Creating a bicycle safety device which utilizes two cameras and millimeter wave radar.  This device will predict collisions before they happen and will notify the cyclist.  Python and MATLAB are being implemented to complete this project.

projects.title: Path Finding Robot
projects.description: Design and implemented a pathfinding algorithm for a robot.  Uses python, pi camera, rotary encoders, Arduino Uno and raspberry pi.  Pathfinding algorithm was implemented using a cost field then integrating over the change for each point.  Robot was successfully ably to locate target, approach the target and circle 360 degrees around the target with in one foot with out touching the target.
